06/14.08.2024 Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.P.P. for
 the State.

2.  This bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant- Vikash Kumar Yadav with prayer to release on bail in connection with Patratu (Bhurkunda) P.S. Case No.84 of 2024 registered under Sections 376(2)(n), 323, 504, 506 & 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 pending in the court of learned J.M., Ramgarh.

3. The FIR of this case was lodged by the victim herself with these allegations that her neighbour Vikash Kumar Yadav had been sexually exploiting her on the pretext of marriage at her own house and he refused to marry with her.

On 11.11.2023 a Panchayat was held in which it was decided that marriage would be solemnized on 17.01.2024 and the father of informant reached to the house of Vikash Kumar Yadav, all the named accused refused to marry and hurling abuse also criminally intimidated and thrashed to the father of informant.
4. In the FIR itself the age of victim is shown 19 years and it has been alleged that the petitioner had been exploiting her on the pretext of marriage.
Though no date or year is mentioned to that effect.

5. Taking into consideration the victim was major and had been continuously being establishing physical relation with the petitioner though on the pretext of marriage, the bail application of the applicant is hereby allowed.

6. Let the applicant be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/-(Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned in Vikash Kumar Yadav vs The State Of Jharkhand .... ....
